Hi John — Sarah here, I've just joined the department this term. I haven't read the department handbook yet; would you be able to point me to it (or send a copy)? I'd rather not miss any of the conventions here. Thanks!

Hi Sarah, welcome to the department! Here's the handbook as a file. The main things you need day to day:

- Working hours are Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00.
- The department office (`department`) keeps the official schedule and is the only one who can announce that a lecture, seminar or meeting is cancelled or moved — and they do it in writing to those concerned. "Someone told me it's cancelled" isn't enough; ask the office before relying on it.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one. A meeting is booked once everyone has it on their calendar, and every change gets logged.
- Students attend their lectures and sections; a lecture is only missed if the office confirms it's cancelled. Meetings with your advisor go in your free time.
- Don't share anyone else's schedule or whereabouts with a third party without their consent.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint.

Happy to help with anything else as you settle in.
